scripts.build:plugins: bun build src/plugins/index.ts --outfile public/plugins.js --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.dev:plugins: bun build src/plugins/index.ts --outfile public/plugins.js --target browser --format esm --watch
scripts.build:assets: bun run build:css && bun run build:runtime && bun run build:plugins
scripts.start: bun run routes:generate && bun run build:assets && bun src/index.ts
scripts.dev: bunx concurrently "bun run dev:css" "bun run dev:runtime" "bun run dev:plugins" "bun --hot src/index.ts"
scripts.build: bun run routes:generate && bun run build:assets && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun
scripts.build:prod: bun run routes:generate && bun run build:assets && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --minify --release
scripts.build:runtime: bun build src/honostar/client/bootstrap/standard.ts --outfile public/runtime.js --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.dev:runtime: bun build src/honostar/client/bootstrap/standard.ts --outfile public/runtime.js --target browser --format esm --watch
scripts.check: bun run format && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
